name: v2.3.3
body:
## What's Changed
* chore(deps): clear 3 of 4 Dependabot alerts (browserslist, @humanfs/node, fflate) by @tonychang04 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2048
* chore(deps): vitest 4.1.11, nodemailer 9.1.1, js-yaml 4.3.2 by @tonychang04 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2057
* chore(deps): bump qs and body-parser by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2061
* docs(readme): add ZopDay to the One-click Deployment table by @muskanbandta23 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2078
* BUG: Adopt staged blue-green strategy for container updates by @prakharsingh-74 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2076
* fix(docker): ship csv-parse and multer in the production image by @Fermionic-Lyu in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2090
* fix(deployments): honor function regions for API deployments by @Fermionic-Lyu in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2091
* 2026-09-13 fix mintlify docs by @insforge-docs-bot[bot] in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2062
* fix(database): restrict http extension functions to project_admin by @Fermionic-Lyu in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2098
* chore(deps): fix open Dependabot vulnerabilities by @jwfing in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2095
* fix(deps): resolve open Dependabot alerts by @jwfing in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2096
* Bump version to 2.3.3 by @agent-zhang-beihai[bot] in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2101

## New Contributors
* @dependabot[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2061
* @muskanbandta23 made their first contribution in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2078

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/compare/v2.3.2...v2.3.3
